record.bible_text: How beautiful<WH03302><WTH8804> are thy feet<WH06471> with shoes<WH05275>, O prince's<WH05081> daughter<WH01323>! the joints<WH02542> of thy thighs<WH03409> <FI>are<Fi> like jewels<WH02481>, the work<WH04639> of the hands<WH03027> of a cunning workman<WH0542>.
